entities.name: Michał Ruciak

entities.summary: Michał Zygmunt Ruciak is a Polish former professional volleyball player. He was a member of the Poland national team from 2004 to 2014, a participant in the Olympic Games London 2012, the 2009 European Champion and the 2012 World League winner.
